opportunities.name: Y Combinator — Fall 2026 Batch
opportunities.what: The definitive startup accelerator. $500K investment for ~7% equity. 3-month program in SF.
opportunities.deadline_note: Estimated — Fall batch applications typically open June, close August. Check ycombinator.com/apply.
opportunities.fit_notes: Working MVP, real market, privacy differentiator, pre-revenue is fine. YC funds college founders constantly. Start writing answers now even before the window opens — they take time.
opportunities.action: Draft your YC application now. Key questions: 'What do you make?', 'What's a problem people have that you solve?', 'How far along are you?'. Get a draft done before the window opens.

opportunities.name: Dorm Room Fund
opportunities.what: First Round Capital's student preseed fund. $90K-$250K uncapped SAFE. No board seat. Rolling.
opportunities.deadline_note: Rolling — apply this week. No reason to wait.
opportunities.fit_notes: You are their exact profile — college founder, working product, real institutional market. Strong privacy story and B2B SaaS are both things they fund.
opportunities.action: Apply today. Takes 20 minutes. Rolling means the sooner the better.

opportunities.name: Thiel Fellowship
opportunities.what: $250K over 2 years to skip/leave college and build your startup. The most prestigious founder fellowship.
opportunities.deadline_note: Rolling — applications accepted year-round. Must be under 22. Must be willing to pause/leave college.
opportunities.fit_notes: Long shot statistically (dozens selected per year), but the profile fits: you're under 22, have a working product, real market, novel privacy angle. The mental health market urgency and NCAA policy angle make a compelling narrative. Apply.
opportunities.action: Apply even if it feels unlikely. The application itself forces you to sharpen your story. Downside is zero.

opportunities.name: FSU InNOLEvation® Challenge
opportunities.what: FSU's flagship annual startup competition. $10K first prize, $7K second, $4K third.
opportunities.deadline_note: Estimated — annual competition, applications typically open fall semester. Walk into Jim Moran College and ask this week.
opportunities.fit_notes: You're an FSU student. This is the home court advantage. An FSU student just won the ACC InVenture People's Choice in April 2026, which means FSU's entrepreneurship ecosystem is active right now.
opportunities.action: Walk into the Jim Moran College of Entrepreneurship this week. Introduce yourself. Ask about InNOLEvation timing and whether there are office hours or mentor sessions before applications open.

opportunities.name: ACC InVenture Prize 2027
opportunities.what: ACC-wide student innovation competition. FSU selects ONE team. $30K in prizes. Televised final.
opportunities.deadline_note: Internal FSU selection ~Feb 2027. An FSU student just won People's Choice in April 2026 — the program is active at FSU. Get on their radar now.
opportunities.fit_notes: B2B SaaS for NCAA institutions is strong for an ACC competition — athletics angle is uniquely relevant. Win the FSU internal selection first, then go to the finals. People's Choice win in 2026 shows FSU sends competitive teams.
opportunities.action: Email the Jim Moran College entrepreneurship coordinator now and ask how FSU selects its ACC InVenture representative. Get in that room.

opportunities.name: VentureWell E-Team Program
opportunities.what: Non-dilutive grant up to $25K for student innovators solving social/health challenges. Includes training and mentorship.
opportunities.deadline_note: Summer 2026 deadline was April 28 (passed). Winter 2027 cohort deadline estimated ~Jan 2027.
opportunities.fit_notes: Mental health tech solving a pressing social need — exactly their mandate. Currently enrolled student check. Health impact + educational institution context is a strong fit.
opportunities.action: Set a reminder for December 2026 to apply for the Winter 2027 cohort. Sign up for their mailing list now.

opportunities.name: NSF I-Corps
opportunities.what: $50K non-dilutive government grant + intensive customer discovery training. Designed for early-stage tech commercialization.
opportunities.deadline_note: Rolling cohorts. Fall 2026 cohort applications likely open summer. Check nsf.gov/i-corps and your regional I-Corps Hub (Southeast Hub).
opportunities.fit_notes: Not purely 'deep tech' in the NSF sense, but the mental health data processing and privacy architecture have a technical core. The customer discovery framework is independently valuable — forces 100 customer interviews. High ROI regardless of the money.
opportunities.action: Find your FSU faculty contact for I-Corps — the program requires a PI (faculty member). Contact the Jim Moran College or FSU Research Foundation to identify who to team with.

opportunities.name: a16z Speedrun — SR008
opportunities.what: Andreessen Horowitz's accelerator. $500K for 10% equity. 12 weeks in SF. ~50-70 companies per cohort.
opportunities.deadline_note: SR007 deadline was May 17 (just closed). SR008 applications estimated fall 2026.
opportunities.fit_notes: SR007 just closed 4 days ago. SR008 will be the next shot. a16z has funded EdTech and consumer health. Privacy-first SaaS with B2B institutional distribution is their kind of story.
opportunities.action: Subscribe to a16z blog and speedrun mailing list. When SR008 opens, apply immediately — don't wait until the deadline.

opportunities.name: Techstars Northwestern Medicine Healthcare Accelerator
opportunities.what: Techstars' healthcare-focused track with Northwestern Medicine. $120K investment. 13-week Chicago program.
opportunities.deadline_note: Spring 2026 is running now. Fall/Winter 2026 applications estimated summer. Check techstars.com/accelerators/northwestern-medicine-healthcare.
opportunities.fit_notes: Mental health tech is explicitly in scope. Healthcare + higher education intersection is unusual — that's your wedge. The Northwestern Medicine brand carries weight in conversations with university health systems.
opportunities.action: Check application window. If open, apply. If not, set a reminder and follow their social for application announcements.

opportunities.name: e-Fest Student Startup Competition
opportunities.what: National student startup competition. $250K in total cash prizes split across teams.
opportunities.deadline_note: 2026 deadline was March 1, 2026 (passed). 2027 cycle will open fall 2026.
opportunities.fit_notes: Undergraduate eligible. National stage. A working B2B MVP with a clear institutional buyer and compliance hook will stand out in a field of B2C consumer apps.
opportunities.action: Mark calendar for fall 2026 when applications open. Use InNOLEvation and ACC InVenture as pitch practice before this.

opportunities.name: SXSW EDU Launch Startup Competition 2027
opportunities.what: EdTech startup showcase at SXSW EDU in Austin. High visibility, investor access, media coverage.
opportunities.deadline_note: Annual. SXSW EDU 2027 applications typically open fall 2026.
opportunities.amount: Visibility + investor exposure (no listed cash prize)
opportunities.fit_notes: EdTech is the explicit focus. NCAA wellness platform is a strong story at an education conference. Media coverage of SXSW EDU is significant for early-stage credibility.
opportunities.action: Watch for fall 2026 applications. Build the EdTech narrative — not just 'athlete app' but 'institutional wellness infrastructure'.

opportunities.name: FSU Seminole Innovators Shark Tank
opportunities.what: FSU student pitch competition. $1K prize. Lower stakes — good for practice and campus visibility.
opportunities.deadline_note: Runs each semester. Check FSU Events Calendar.
opportunities.fit_notes: Home court. Low effort to enter. The real value is practice reps and meeting FSU entrepreneurship faculty who can connect you to bigger opportunities.
opportunities.action: Enter the next one regardless of prize size. Treat it as practice for InNOLEvation and ACC InVenture.
